feedback.problem: Find the principal $12$th root of unity.
feedback.worked_solution:
Let $z$ be a $12$th root of unity. This means that 

$$
{z}^{12}=1.
$$

First, we express the complex number $1$ in the form $r{e}^{\text{i}\theta }.$ Notice that $|1|=1$ and $\operatorname{arg}⁡(1)=0.$ Hence, 

$$
1={e}^{\text{i}(0+2k\pi )}={e}^{2k\pi \text{i}},
$$

where $k$ is an integer. So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{z}^{12}={e}^{2k\pi \text{i}}\,⟹\,z=({e}^{2k\pi \text{i}})^{1/12}={e}^{k\pi \text{i}/6}.\end{aligned}
$$

The principal root corresponds to $k=1,$ and is therefore equal to ${e}^{\pi \text{i}/6}.$
